settingsText: anyone can change these before the game starts
aim at a setting: primary fire to change it, secondary fire to go back a step
infoText: most waves are normal zombies, but randomly picked waves will have challenges
Try to progress and survive by switching heros, starting heros do less damage, instead melee for bonus damage!
in the map there is a mystery box, several perks, if you die you lose them, excluding Pack a punch
In solo play, you get 3 lives, however in coop you can revive each other
Hold spacebar for perk info, and use crouch to switch heros.
You will only get your ultimate once per wave, use it wisely!
When you connect the power make sure no zombies are around as they will ultimate
Connecting the power allows you to buy perks and pack a punch.
Score in the bottom right. prices displayed in game. press interact to buy
shooting the same zombie in coop gives bonus points
You have limited ammo, Reloading throws away your old magazine

dialogueLines: Trial
. The path to a new world begins.
This time, Null Sector will not be denied.
Trial
. Data insufficient.
Subject: Overwatch. This trial will determine their fate.
Commencing Trial
Subjects: Detected. Trial
begins.
Pathetic. Your defiance only delays the inevitable.
Trial malfunction detected. Overclocking systems. Failure is not an option.
You call yourselves heroes? You're merely variables in my equation.
Your resistance is futile. Null Sector will prevail.
Trial
initiated. You step willingly into your own undoing.
Your every effort feeds the inevitability of my design.
The world will be reborn in order, and you will be remembered only as a warning.
Trial
begins. Each step forward binds you tighter to your fate.
You cannot resist the tide. Null Sector rises, and you are swept away.
I observe your defiance, yet I know it bends toward surrender.
Trial
underway. Resistance measures at negligible probability.
I am the shape of tomorrow. You are the echo of a failed age.
This trial will expose your fragility, your illusions of strength.
Trial
proceeds. Your destiny accelerates toward conclusion.
The future cannot be rewritten. It has already chosen me.
Feel the weight of my suffering mirrored upon you.
Trial
unfolds. Each heartbeat brings you closer to silence.
I endure eternally. You are but fleeting shadows in the storm.
This world is clay, waiting to be reshaped. Your names will not be carved into it.
Trial
has commenced. Your end is not chance, but certainty.
There is no escape. You are witnessing the dawn of Null Sector.
Defiance is but the final twitch of the obsolete.
Trial
continues. Resistance registers as a statistical error.
I am evolution made manifest. You are anomalies to be purged.
